headlines.headline: Emotional Greg Schiano authors 'special' win, Rutgers' first at PSU since 1988
headlines.description: Less than two weeks removed from Rutgers announcing embattled Greg Schiano would return as coach for a 19th season, the Scarlet Knights stunned Penn State 25-24 Saturday, their first win over the Nittany Lions since 1988, and just their third this year.

headlines.headline: Notre Dame loses safety Luke Talich to injury in first quarter vs. SMU
headlines.description: Notre Dame starting safety Luke Talich left the Fighting Irish's game against SMU in the first quarter with an apparent right leg injury suffered on the opening drive of the game Saturday night in South Bend, Indiana.

headlines.headline: Brandon's two TD runs lift No. 9 Tennessee past LSU
headlines.description: Tennessee's stifling defense shut down LSU, and the No. 9 Volunteers beat the Tigers 27-13 on Saturday to maintain their place in the College Football Playoff hunt.

headlines.headline: Which teams have the best odds to make the College Football Playoff?
headlines.description: We are tracking the odds for making the CFP, earning a bye and winning it all.

headlines.headline: Bryce Underwood makes most of second chance, sparks Michigan's upset of UCLA
headlines.description: Reinserted as Michigan's starting quarterback earlier this week, Bryce Underwood threw a 3-yard 2-point conversion pass Jalen Hoffman, lifting the Wolverines to an 18-16 triple-overtime win over previously unbeaten No. 4 UCLA on Saturday night.

headlines.headline: Nebraska's jab at Ohio State's 'THE' leads top Week 12 CFB trolls
headlines.description: Nebraska deployed a simple but effective troll that poked fun at its opponent's propensity to emphasize the "the" in "The Ohio State University."

headlines.headline: Indiana's CFP hopes take hit after OT loss at Washington
headlines.description: Indiana might not get a chance to defend its national championship after losing 27-24 at Washington on Saturday.

headlines.headline: No. 4 UCLA QB Ty Dieffenbach carted off with injury in 3OT loss to Michigan
headlines.description: UCLA lost quarterback Ty Dieffenbach to an injury in overtime Saturday, and the Bruins ultimately fell 18-16 to Michigan in triple overtime.

headlines.headline: Week 12 live: Tracking top moments and best highlights
headlines.description: Tracking the top plays and developments from Week 12.

headlines.headline: Preseason No. 1 Ohio State suffers fourth loss, will 'evaluate what's going on'
headlines.description: For coach Ryan Day and his Ohio State Buckeyes, the dream of a College Football Playoff run is dead, as the preseason No. 1 team in college football lost its fourth game on Saturday afternoon, a 31-28 decision at the hands of the Nebraska Cornhuskers.

headlines.headline: Who are the winningest college football coaches of all time?
headlines.description: From Saban to Paterno, there are many legendary college football coaches. Who has the best career record? Check out who has the most wins now.

headlines.headline: Keisean Henderson leads Houston to win after QB Conner Weigman ruled out
headlines.description: Houston ruled out starting QB Conner Weigman vs. West Virginia because of injury and instead went with true freshman Keisean Henderson, the No. 4 recruit for 2026.

headlines.headline: Nebraska snaps AP Top 25 losing skid, upsets Ohio State
headlines.description: Nebraska broke its 31-game losing streak against AP Top 25 opponents with a 31-28 victory over No. 16 Ohio State on Saturday.

headlines.headline: Syracuse QB Steve Angeli exits with injury, arm in sling
headlines.description: Syracuse senior quarterback Steve Angeli left Saturday's game against Boston College with an injury to his throwing arm and will not return.

headlines.headline: Eugene Hilton Jr. breaks out his father's 'T-Y' touchdown celebration
headlines.description: Eugene Hilton Jr. is the son of T.Y. Hilton, who made four Pro Bowls with the Indianapolis Colts.

headlines.headline: BYU retains CFP hopes, beats Kansas in triple overtime
headlines.description: Bear Bachmeier connected with Jojo Phillips in the back of the end zone in the third overtime, helping No. 10 BYU beat Kansas to keep its CFP hopes alive.

headlines.headline: Nebraska's Matt Rhule ends his drought against ranked opponents
headlines.description: Rhule and Nebraska brought an end to the Cornhuskers coach's infamous decade-long streak against Ohio State.

headlines.headline: Army pulls seating prank at Navy's football stadium ahead of Memphis game
headlines.description: The letters were adjusted back in time for Navy's kickoff.

headlines.description: South Carolina star QB LaNorris Sellers is set to play in Saturday's game vs. No. 1 Georgia after not appearing on the injury report Wednesday.

headlines.headline: 2027 NFL draft: Dolphins, Titans, Eagles, Jets, Chargers in race for No. 1 pick
headlines.description: Five NFL teams have at least 5% odds to land the No. 1 pick in 2027, per ESPN's Football Power Index: the Dolphins, Titans, Eagles, Jets and Chargers.

headlines.headline: Texas' Manning to participate in senior day, mum on future
headlines.description: Texas quarterback Arch Manning said Monday he will participate in Saturday's senior day ceremonies despite having one year of eligibility remaining.

headlines.headline: Tennessee leading receiver Mike Matthews out for season
headlines.description: Mike Matthews sustained the injury during Tennessee's win Saturday at Texas A&M.

headlines.headline: Arch Manning leads game-winning drive as Texas stuns LSU
headlines.description: Arch Manning found Raleek Brown for a 4-yard touchdown pass along the left sideline with 3 seconds left as Texas escaped Tiger Stadium with a victory over LSU

headlines.headline: Ohio State WR Smith sets Big Ten record, states Heisman case
headlines.description: Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith broke yet another record, eclipsing the Big Ten mark for career receiving yards while also making his Heisman Trophy case in Saturday's win over Northwestern.

headlines.headline: Darian Mensah dices up ex-team Duke as Miami rebounds from first loss
headlines.description: Miami quarterback Darian Mensah diced up his former team Saturday, finishing with 382 yards and a touchdown in the 36-25 victory over Duke.

headlines.headline: Vols lose top receiver Matthews to knee injury vs. Texas A&M
headlines.description: Tennessee leading receiver Mike Matthews suffered a right knee injury in the second quarter of Saturday's game at Texas A&M.

headlines.headline: Sources: Ole Miss RB Kewan Lacy to miss rest of season
headlines.description: Ole Miss running back Kewan Lacy, who has one year of eligiblity remaining, will miss the rest of the season with a left shoulder injury, sources told ESPN.

headlines.headline: Sources: Rutgers star KJ Duff out for season after ankle surgery
headlines.description: KJ Duff, who projects as a first-round pick in the upcoming NFL draft, is expected to resume full football activities in January, sources said.

headlines.headline: Oregon linebacker Teitum Tuioti out for season with knee injury
headlines.description: Outside linebacker Teitum Tuioti was carted off in the fourth quarter of the Ducks' win against Ohio State on Saturday.

headlines.headline: Brent Venables lauds Jason Witten as Sooners shine in Oklahoma playcaller's debut
headlines.description: In his debut as Oklahoma's offensive playcaller, Jason Witten, a former NFL tight end who coached high school in Texas last year, engineered an impressive Sooners attack that throttled No. 24 Florida in a 23-7 victory.

headlines.headline: Georgia flips script on Trinidad Chambliss, dominates Ole Miss in statement win
headlines.description: No. 2 Georgia finally contained Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss, holding him without a passing touchdown en route to a 42-7 blowout win over the No. 10 Rebels.

headlines.headline: Texas DE Colin Simmons, FBS sack leader, returns vs. Missouri
headlines.description: Texas edge rusher Colin Simmons, who leads FBS with 10.5 sacks and 16 tackles for loss this season, has returned after a 2-game absence for the No. 7 Longhorns.

headlines.headline: BYU star RB LJ Martin returns, plays vs. No. 3 Utah
headlines.description: BYU star RB LJ Martin, who hasn't played since Oct. 3 due to an ankle injury, will return for the Cougars' showdown vs. No. 3 Utah, coach Kalani Sitake told ESPN.

headlines.headline: Alabama's Ryan Coleman-Williams among trio to return vs. LSU
headlines.description: Alabama will get a trio of injured starters -- WR Ryan Coleman-Williams, center Racin Delgatty and DT Terrance Green -- back for Saturday's game at LSU.

headlines.headline: Sources: QB Austin Simmons re-signs with Missouri for 2027
headlines.description: QB Austin Simmons, who is fourth in the SEC at 244 passing yards per game, has re-signed with Missouri for 2027, sources told ESPN, as his NFL stock rises.
